M1 provides: showing the floating button, dragging it, edge snapping on release, tap handling, position memory, and the overlay / notification permission flow.

M2 provides: a long-lived capture session after a single consent, grabbing the current frame on tap, and a preview of the grabbed frame (to confirm it is fresh and does not contain the button itself).

M3 will crop the grabbed frame to the selected region and call DeepSeek.
